name: Assisted living facility minimum staffing requirements by US state — how many staff must be on duty, and what that guarantees
description: State-by-state comparison of minimum staffing requirements for assisted living facilities (distinct from nursing homes/skilled nursing facilities, which run under a separate federal-plus-state regime). Assisted living regulation is entirely state-run — there is no federal minimum — and states take genuinely different regulatory approaches, not just different numbers on the same form: North Carolina sets a headcount rule that scales by facility census (13-20 residents requires an administrator or manager within 500 feet plus at least one awake staff member per shift, with specific carve-outs for when housekeeping duties may or may not be combined with care duties); Georgia sets a flat always-present rule (at least two trained staff present at all times any resident is present, with at least one per occupied floor), a 1:15 waking / 1:20 non-waking awake direct-care ratio, banded on-site nurse hours, and separate continuing-education hour requirements (24 hours in year one, 16 hours annually after); Florida runs a facility-size-banded staff-hours-per-week table (total weekly staff hours required scale with combined resident/day-care/respite census, with an incremental add-on above 95); Pennsylvania sets hours per resident per day rather than a facility total (1 hour for a mobile resident, 2 hours for a resident with mobility needs, at least 75% of it in waking hours); California's only real number is at night, banded by census from 'a qualified person on call on the premises' under 16 residents up to one extra awake staff member per further 100; Texas splits the night rule by licence type rather than size (Type B night staff must be awake whatever the bed count, Type A only in a large facility); and Virginia, Washington and Minnesota state no number at all, requiring staffing 'sufficient' or 'adequate' against each resident's own assessment or service agreement, with a single awake or available responder as the floor. One record per distinct rule, so a facility of a given size can be looked up directly. Answers 'how many caregivers are legally required to be on duty at my parent's assisted living facility', and 'what's the difference between assisted living staffing rules and nursing home staffing rules'.

records.rule_scope: a direct care staff person aged 21 or over present whenever any resident is in the residence
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: At all times one or more residents are present in the residence, a direct care staff person who is 21 years of age or older shall be present in the residence.
records.source_quote: (a) At all times one or more residents are present in the residence, a direct care staff person who is 21 years of age or older shall be present in the residence. The direct care staff person may be the administrator if the administrator provides direct care services.

records.rule_scope: a First Aid and CPR certified staff member must be in the facility at all times
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: A staff member who has completed courses in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and holds a currently valid card documenting completion of such courses must be in the facility at all times
records.training_or_ce_requirement: completed courses in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and holds a currently valid card documenting completion of such courses
records.source_quote: 5. A staff member who has completed courses in First Aid and Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and holds a currently valid card documenting completion of such courses must be in the facility at all times. a. records.rule_scope: all adult care homes — duty to staff to the resident census, and never to leave residents alone
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Adult care homes shall staff based on the facility's resident census and provide staffing to meet the care and supervision needs of the residents in accordance with the rules of this Subchapter
records.source_quote: (a) Adult care homes shall staff based on the facility's resident census and provide staffing to meet the care and supervision needs of the residents in accordance with the rules of this Subchapter. (b) At no time shall residents be left alone without a staff member in the facility.

records.rule_scope: all adult care homes — required supervisors and aides per shift must be posted where residents and visitors can see them
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The facility shall post daily staffing information in a location accessible to residents and visitors in accordance with G.S. 131D-4.3(a)(5)
records.source_quote: (d) The facility shall post daily staffing information in a location accessible to residents and visitors in accordance with G.S. 131D-4.3(a)(5). The information shall include: (1) the name and contact information of the administrator and manager; (2) the number of required supervisors on each shift; and (3) the number of aides required on each shift.

records.rule_scope: all assisted living facilities — staffing judged against resident assessments and individualised service plans, with no minimum number stated
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: staff adequate in knowledge, skills, and abilities and sufficient in numbers to provide services to attain and maintain the physical, mental, and psychosocial well-being of each resident as determined by resident assessments and individualized service plans
records.source_quote: A. The assisted living facility shall have staff adequate in knowledge, skills, and abilities and sufficient in numbers to provide services to attain and maintain the physical, mental, and psychosocial well-being of each resident as determined by resident assessments and individualized service plans, and to ensure compliance with this chapter.

records.rule_scope: all assisted living facilities — staffing ratios set by the facility from residents' service plans, not by the state
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: A facility must develop and implement staffing policies, which require staffing ratios based upon the needs of the residents, as identified in their service plans.
records.source_quote: (1) A facility must develop and implement staffing policies, which require staffing ratios based upon the needs of the residents, as identified in their service plans.

records.rule_scope: all assisted living facilities — staffing sufficient for each resident's negotiated service agreement, with no minimum number stated
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Each assisted living facility must provide sufficient, trained staff persons to: (a) Furnish the services and care needed by each resident consistent with their negotiated service agreement; (b) Maintain the assisted living facility free of safety hazards; and (c) Implement fire and disaster plans.
records.source_quote: (1) Each assisted living facility must provide sufficient, trained staff persons to: (a) Furnish the services and care needed by each resident consistent with their negotiated service agreement; (b) Maintain the assisted living facility free of safety hazards; and (c) Implement fire and disaster plans.

records.rule_scope: an attendant in the facility whenever residents are in it, and the minimum age or education of a full-time attendant
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: An attendant must be in the facility at all times when residents are in the facility.
records.source_quote: (b) Attendants. Full-time facility attendants must be at least 18 years old or a high-school graduate. (1) An attendant must be in the facility at all times when residents are in the facility.

records.rule_scope: annual continuing education hours from the second year of employment onwards
records.training_or_ce_requirement: a minimum of sixteen (16) hours of job-related continuing education
records.source_quote: (6) Ongoing Staff Training. records.rule_scope: at least two trained staff present at all times any residents are present, one per occupied floor
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: must be present in the assisted living community at all times any residents are present, with at least one staff person on each occupied floor
records.source_quote: (4) Trained Staff Present. At least two staff who have completed the minimum training requirements of Rule <https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/georgia/Ga-Comp-R-Regs-R-111-8-63-.09> 111-8-63-.09 (2)(a) through (d) and (3)(a) through (e) above must be present in the assisted living community at all times any residents are present, with at least one staff person on each occupied floor, to provide necessary oversight and assistance to staff providing hands-on personal services who have not completed the training, to ensure that care and services are delivered safely and in accordance with these rules.

records.rule_scope: average monthly minimum awake direct care staff-to-resident ratio, waking and non-waking hours
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: an average monthly minimum on-site staff to resident ratio of one awake direct care staff person per 15 residents during waking hours and one awake direct care staff person per 20 residents during non-waking hours where the residents have minimal care needs
records.awake_staff_requirement: one awake direct care staff person per 15 residents during waking hours and one awake direct care staff person per 20 residents during non-waking hours
records.source_quote: (18) The community must maintain an average monthly minimum on-site staff to resident ratio of one awake direct care staff person per 15 residents during waking hours and one awake direct care staff person per 20 residents during non-waking hours where the residents have minimal care needs. Average monthly minimum staffing levels shall be calculated and documented by the community using methods and forms specified by the department. However, the assisted living community must staff above these minimum on-site staff ratios to meet the specific residents' ongoing health, safety and care needs.

records.rule_scope: buildings of 19 or fewer residents licensed for residential living care only — when the night staff member need not be awake
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: For a facility licensed for residential living care only, in buildings that house 19 or fewer residents, the staff member on duty does not have to be awake during the night
records.awake_staff_requirement: the staff member on duty does not have to be awake during the night if (i) none of the residents have care needs that require a staff member awake at night
records.source_quote: Exception: For a facility licensed for residential living care only, in buildings that house 19 or fewer residents, the staff member on duty does not have to be awake during the night if (i) none of the residents have care needs that require a staff member awake at night

records.rule_scope: census of greater than 12 but less than 21 residents — administrator or manager presence
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times
records.source_quote: (a) In a facility with a census of greater than 12 but less than 21 residents, there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times.

records.rule_scope: census of greater than 12 but less than 21 residents — one awake staff member on every shift when the administrator or manager is not on duty
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: there shall be at least one awake staff member on duty on the first, second, and third shifts
records.awake_staff_requirement: there shall be at least one awake staff member on duty on the first, second, and third shifts
records.source_quote: (a) In a facility with a census of greater than 12 but less than 21 residents, there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times. (b) When the administrator or manager is not on duty within the facility, there shall be at least one awake staff member on duty on the first, second, and third shifts.

records.rule_scope: census of greater than six but less than 13 residents — administrator or manager presence
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times
records.source_quote: (a) In a facility with a census of greater than six but less than 13 residents, there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times.

records.rule_scope: census of greater than six but less than 13 residents — staff on duty when the administrator or manager is not on duty
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: there shall be at least one staff member on-duty on the first and second shifts and at least one staff member available within the building, who need not be on-duty, on third shift
records.awake_staff_requirement: If there are residents in the facility who are disoriented or known to have wandering behavior, there shall be at least one staff member on-duty and awake at all times
records.source_quote: (a) In a facility with a census of greater than six but less than 13 residents, there shall be an administrator or manager in the facility or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times. (b) When the administrator or manager is not on-duty, there shall be at least one staff member on-duty on the first and second shifts and at least one staff member available within the building, who need not be on-duty, on third shift. There shall be a call system connecting the bedroom of the available staff member, who may be asleep on the third shift, with each resident's bedroom. If there are residents in the facility who are disoriented or known to have wandering behavior, there shall be at least one staff member on-duty and awake at all times.

records.rule_scope: cluster of adjacent facilities each with capacity or census of 12 or fewer residents
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: When there is a cluster of up to six licensed facilities located adjacently, there shall be at least one administrator or manager who lives within 500 feet of each of the facilities with a means of two- way telecommunication at all times
records.source_quote: (g) A cluster of facilities, each with capacity or census of 12 or fewer residents, shall comply with the following staffing: (1) When there is a cluster of up to six licensed facilities located adjacently, there shall be at least one administrator or manager who lives within 500 feet of each of the facilities with a means of two- way telecommunication at all times. (2) The administrator or manager on-duty shall be directly responsible for assuring that all required daily duties are carried out in each facility.

records.rule_scope: continuing education hours required during the first year of employment as a direct care worker
records.training_or_ce_requirement: a total of at least twenty-four (24) hours of continuing education within the first year of employment as a direct care worker
records.source_quote: (5) Training Hours Required During First Year of Employment. All staff offering hands-on personal services to the residents, including the administrator or on-site manager, must satisfactorily complete a total of at least twenty-four (24) hours of continuing education within the first year of employment as a direct care worker.

records.rule_scope: enough qualified staff regardless of the minimum hours table, including apartment-style facilities

records.rule_scope: facilities caring for 16 to 100 residents — night supervision
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: In facilities caring for sixteen (16) to one hundred (100) residents at least one employee shall be on duty on the premises, and awake. Another employee shall be on call, and capable of responding within ten minutes.
records.awake_staff_requirement: at least one employee shall be on duty on the premises, and awake
records.source_quote: (2) In facilities caring for sixteen (16) to one hundred (100) residents at least one employee shall be on duty on the premises, and awake. Another employee shall be on call, and capable of responding within ten minutes.

records.rule_scope: facilities caring for 101 to 200 residents — night supervision
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: In facilities caring for one hundred one (101) to two hundred (200) residents, one employee shall be on call, on the premises; one employee shall be on duty on the premises and awake; and one employee shall be on call and capable of responding within 10 minutes.

records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The on-site manager and responsible staff persons must be at least 21 years of age and responsible for supervising the provision of care by all other staff
records.source_quote: (1) The on-site manager and responsible staff persons must be at least 21 years of age and responsible for supervising the provision of care by all other staff. No staff person under the age of 18 is permitted to work in the assisted living community unless there is direct line-of-sight supervision being provided by the administrator, on-site manager or a responsible staff person or the staff member is at least 17 years of age and has successfully completed a vocational technical training track as a nursing assistant through a Georgia high school.

records.rule_scope: more than 95 total combined residents, day care participants and respite care residents — incremental staff hours above the table
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: For every 20 total combined residents, day care participants, and respite care residents over 95 add 42 staff hours per week
records.source_quote: 86-95 | 539 | For every 20 total combined residents, day care participants, and respite care residents over 95 add 42 staff hours per week.

records.rule_scope: nurse cover — the on-call registered nurse staff must be able to reach
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: provide staff access to an on-call registered nurse 24 hours per day, seven days per week
records.source_quote: (13) provide staff access to an on-call registered nurse 24 hours per day, seven days per week.

records.rule_scope: office, kitchen, housekeeping, laundry and maintenance work — staff who must be employed on top of the care staff
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Additional staff shall be employed as necessary to perform office work, cooking, house cleaning, laundering, and maintenance of buildings, equipment and grounds.
records.source_quote: Additional staff shall be employed as necessary to perform office work, cooking, house cleaning, laundering, and maintenance of buildings, equipment and grounds.

records.rule_scope: one awake direct care staff member per building, whenever any resident is present
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: At least one direct care staff member shall be awake and on duty at all times in each building when at least one resident is present.
records.awake_staff_requirement: At least one direct care staff member shall be awake and on duty at all times in each building when at least one resident is present.
records.source_quote: D. At least one direct care staff member shall be awake and on duty at all times in each building when at least one resident is present.

records.rule_scope: one caregiver aged 18 or over, CPR and first-aid certified, present whenever residents are on the premises and on off-site activities
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Ensure at least one caregiver, who is 18 years of age or older and has current cardiopulmonary resuscitation and first-aid cards, is present and available to assist residents at all times
records.source_quote: (f) Ensure at least one caregiver, who is 18 years of age or older and has current cardiopulmonary resuscitation and first-aid cards, is present and available to assist residents at all times: (i) When one or more residents are present on the assisted living facility premises; and (ii) During assisted living facility activities off of the assisted living facility premises.

records.rule_scope: one staff member per shift assigned to personal care, barred from food service and restricted in housekeeping duties (7 to 12 residents)
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Each facility shall assign at least one staff member per shift to provide personal care services and supervision of residents as needed by the residents
records.source_quote: (e) Each facility shall assign at least one staff member per shift to provide personal care services and supervision of residents as needed by the residents. The staff member so assigned shall not perform food service duties during the shift of rendering care services and supervision. The staff member so assigned shall not perform housekeeping duties during the shift of rendering care services and supervision, except: (1) between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m., and then only when the housekeeping duties are incidental to the rendering of care services; and (2) between the hours of 9:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m. and then only to the extent that the housekeeping duties do not hinder the assigned staff's duties of care or immediate response to residents, nor impede the assigned staff member's ability to monitor the residents. (f) There shall be additional staff to provide daily housekeeping and food service duties.

records.rule_scope: one staff member per shift assigned to personal care, barred from food service and restricted in housekeeping duties (13 to 20 residents)
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Each facility shall assign at least one staff member per shift to provide personal care services and supervision of residents as needed by the residents
records.source_quote: (d) Each facility shall assign at least one staff member per shift to provide personal care services and supervision of residents as needed by the residents. The staff member so assigned shall not perform food service duties during the shift of rendering care services and supervision. The staff member so assigned shall not perform housekeeping duties during the shift of rendering care services and supervision, except; (1) between the hours of 7:00 a.m. and 9:00 p.m., and then only when the housekeeping duties are incidental to the rendering of care services; and (2) between the hours of 9:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m., and then only to the extent that the housekeeping duties do not hinder the assigned staff's duties of care or immediate response to residents, nor impede the assigned staff member's ability to monitor the residents. (e) There shall be additional staff to provide daily housekeeping and food service duties.

records.rule_scope: one staff member with access to facility and resident records must be present whenever residents are in the facility
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: At least one staff member who has access to facility and resident records in case of an emergency must be in the facility at all times when residents are in the facility
records.source_quote: 3. At least one staff member who has access to facility and resident records in case of an emergency must be in the facility at all times when residents are in the facility. Residents serving as paid or volunteer staff may not be left solely in charge of other residents while the facility administrator, manager or other staff are absent from the facility.

records.rule_scope: only staff actually on the job count towards the minimum staffing hours
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Only on-the-job staff may be counted in meeting the minimum staffing hours. Vacant positions or absent staff may not be counted
records.source_quote: 9. Only on-the-job staff may be counted in meeting the minimum staffing hours. Vacant positions or absent staff may not be counted.

records.rule_scope: orientation every staff member must complete before taking on any job responsibilities
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: All staff members must complete four hours of orientation before assuming any job responsibilities.
records.training_or_ce_requirement: four hours of orientation before assuming any job responsibilities
records.source_quote: (1) All staff members must complete four hours of orientation before assuming any job responsibilities.

records.rule_scope: residential care facilities for the elderly — personnel sufficient in numbers and competent, with no minimum number stated
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Facility personnel shall at all times be sufficient in numbers, and competent to provide the services necessary to meet resident needs.
records.source_quote: (a) Facility personnel shall at all times be sufficient in numbers, and competent to provide the services necessary to meet resident needs.

records.rule_scope: second staff member required when the administrator or manager is on duty on the first or second shifts
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: another staff member (i.e., co-administrator, manager or aide) shall be in the building or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times
records.source_quote: (c) When the administrator or manager is on duty on the first or second shifts and available within the facility on third shift, another staff member (i.e., co-administrator, manager or aide) shall be in the building or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times.

records.rule_scope: second staff member required when the administrator or manager is on duty within the facility
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: another staff member (i.e. co-administrator, manager or aide) shall be in the building or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times and available to assist if needed
records.source_quote: (c) When the administrator or manager is on duty within the facility, another staff member (i.e. co-administrator, manager or aide) shall be in the building or within 500 feet of the facility with a means of two-way telecommunication at all times and available to assist if needed.

records.rule_scope: staff who may not be counted towards the minimum staffing ratios
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Staff, such as cooks and maintenance staff, who do not receive on-going direct care training and whose job duties do not routinely involve the oversight or delivery of direct personal care to the residents, must not be counted towards these minimum staffing ratios
records.source_quote: (a) Staff, such as cooks and maintenance staff, who do not receive on-going direct care training and whose job duties do not routinely involve the oversight or delivery of direct personal care to the residents, must not be counted towards these minimum staffing ratios. Personnel who work for another entity, such as a private home care provider, hospice, etc. or private sitters cannot be counted in the staff ratios for the assisted living community.

records.rule_scope: staff who must be on the premises at all times to carry out the fire and emergency evacuation plan
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: An adequate number of staff persons shall be on the premises at all times to implement the approved fire and emergency evacuation plan.
records.source_quote: C. An adequate number of staff persons shall be on the premises at all times to implement the approved fire and emergency evacuation plan.

records.rule_scope: staffing above the minimum when the agency finds supervision or care inadequate
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The facility must immediately increase staff above the minimum levels established in paragraph (a), if the agency determines that adequate supervision and care are not being provided to residents
records.source_quote: (d) The facility must provide staff immediately when the agency determines that the requirements of paragraph (a) are not met. The facility must immediately increase staff above the minimum levels established in paragraph (a), if the agency determines that adequate supervision and care are not being provided to residents, resident care standards described in rule <https://www.law.cornell.edu/regulations/florida/Fla-Admin-Code-Ann-R-59A-36-007> 59A-36.007 , F.A.C., are not being met, or that the facility is failing to meet the terms of residents' contracts.

records.rule_scope: staffing plans and monthly work schedules showing planned and actual coverage
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: must develop and maintain accurate staffing plans that take into account the specific needs of the residents and monthly work schedules for all employees, including relief workers, showing planned and actual coverage for each day and night
records.source_quote: (21) All assisted living communities must develop and maintain accurate staffing plans that take into account the specific needs of the residents and monthly work schedules for all employees, including relief workers, showing planned and actual coverage for each day and night. The assisted living community must retain the completed staff schedules for a minimum of one year.

records.rule_scope: supervised on-the-job training an attendant must complete after orientation
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Attendants must complete 16 hours of on-the-job supervision and training within the first 16 hours of employment following orientation.
records.training_or_ce_requirement: 16 hours of on-the-job supervision and training within the first 16 hours of employment following orientation
records.source_quote: Attendants must complete 16 hours of on-the-job supervision and training within the first 16 hours of employment following orientation.

records.rule_scope: temporary absence of the administrator or manager of more than 48 hours
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: a staff member who is at least 21 years of age must be physically present and designated in writing to be in charge of the facility
records.source_quote: 6. During periods of temporary absence of the administrator or manager of more than 48 hours when residents are on the premises, a staff member who is at least 21 years of age must be physically present and designated in writing to be in charge of the facility. No staff member shall be in charge of a facility for a consecutive period of 21 days or more, or for a total of 60 days within a calendar year, without being an administrator or manager.

records.rule_scope: the 24-hour staffing pattern a facility must disclose before admission and post monthly
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Prior to admission, a facility must disclose, to prospective residents and their families, the facility's normal 24-hour staffing pattern
records.source_quote: (2) Prior to admission, a facility must disclose, to prospective residents and their families, the facility's normal 24-hour staffing pattern

records.rule_scope: the awake person who must be available 24 hours a day to answer resident requests, and how far away they may be
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: ensure that one or more persons are available 24 hours per day, seven days per week, who are responsible for responding to the requests of residents for assistance with health or safety needs
records.awake_staff_requirement: Such persons must be: (i) awake; (ii) located in the same building, in an attached building, or on a contiguous campus with the facility in order to respond within a reasonable amount of time
records.source_quote: (12) ensure that one or more persons are available 24 hours per day, seven days per week, who are responsible for responding to the requests of residents for assistance with health or safety needs. Such persons must be: (i) awake; (ii) located in the same building, in an attached building, or on a contiguous campus with the facility in order to respond within a reasonable amount of time; (iii) capable of communicating with residents; (iv) capable of providing or summoning the appropriate assistance; and (v) capable of following directions

records.rule_scope: the hours that count as night supervision, and what the staff providing it must know
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The following persons providing night supervision from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. shall be familiar with the facility's planned emergency procedures
records.source_quote: (a) The following persons providing night supervision from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. shall be familiar with the facility's planned emergency procedures

records.rule_scope: the manager's own hours, and how many facilities or residents one manager may cover
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The manager must be on duty 40 hours per week and may manage only one facility, except for managers of small Type A facilities, who may have responsibility for no more than 16 residents in no more than four facilities.
records.source_quote: The manager must be on duty 40 hours per week and may manage only one facility, except for managers of small Type A facilities, who may have responsibility for no more than 16 residents in no more than four facilities.

records.rule_scope: the staffing plan every assisted living facility must develop, and how often it must be re-evaluated
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: develop and implement a staffing plan for determining its staffing level that: (i) includes an evaluation, to be conducted at least twice a year, of the appropriateness of staffing levels in the facility
records.source_quote: (11) develop and implement a staffing plan for determining its staffing level that: (i) includes an evaluation, to be conducted at least twice a year, of the appropriateness of staffing levels in the facility; (ii) ensures sufficient staffing at all times to meet the scheduled and reasonably foreseeable unscheduled needs of each resident as required by the residents' assessments and service plans on a 24-hour per day basis

records.rule_scope: the written staffing plan every facility must maintain, tied to actual resident acuity
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: a written plan that specifies the number and type of direct care staff required to meet the day-to-day, routine direct care needs and any identified special needs for the residents in care
records.source_quote: B. The assisted living facility shall maintain a written plan that specifies the number and type of direct care staff required to meet the day-to-day, routine direct care needs and any identified special needs for the residents in care. This plan shall be directly related to actual resident acuity levels and individualized care needs.

records.rule_scope: two on-site direct care staff on the premises 24 hours per day whenever residents are present
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: At least two on-site direct care staff persons must be on the premises 24 hours per day providing supervision whenever residents are present, with at least one staff person on each occupied floor
records.source_quote: (b) At least two on-site direct care staff persons must be on the premises 24 hours per day providing supervision whenever residents are present, with at least one staff person on each occupied floor.

records.rule_scope: Type A facilities — night shift, and whether staff must be awake depends on facility size
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Type A facility: Night shift staff in a small facility must be immediately available. In a large facility, the staff must be immediately available and awake.
records.awake_staff_requirement: In a large facility, the staff must be immediately available and awake.
records.source_quote: (A) Type A facility: Night shift staff in a small facility must be immediately available. In a large facility, the staff must be immediately available and awake.

records.rule_scope: Type B facilities — night shift staff must be awake whatever the size of the facility
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Type B facility: Night shift staff must be immediately available and awake, regardless of the number of licensed beds.
records.awake_staff_requirement: Night shift staff must be immediately available and awake, regardless of the number of licensed beds.
records.source_quote: (B) Type B facility: Night shift staff must be immediately available and awake, regardless of the number of licensed beds.

records.rule_scope: weekly staffing schedules the facility must document and keep
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Document and retain for 12 weeks, weekly staffing schedules, as planned and worked
records.source_quote: (d) Document and retain for 12 weeks, weekly staffing schedules, as planned and worked;

records.rule_scope: when the administrator or manager's own hours count towards the required staffing hours
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The administrator or manager's time may be counted for the purpose of meeting the required staffing hours, provided the administrator or manager is actively involved in the day-to-day operation of the facility
records.source_quote: 8. The administrator or manager's time may be counted for the purpose of meeting the required staffing hours, provided the administrator or manager is actively involved in the day-to-day operation of the facility, including making decisions and providing supervision for all aspects of resident care, and is listed on the facility's staffing schedule.

records.rule_scope: when the licensing agency may require staffing above the level the facility has set
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The licensing agency may require any facility to provide additional staff whenever it determines through documentation that the needs of the particular residents, the extent of services provided, or the physical arrangements of the facility require such additional staff for the provision of adequate services.
records.source_quote: The licensing agency may require any facility to provide additional staff whenever it determines through documentation that the needs of the particular residents, the extent of services provided, or the physical arrangements of the facility require such additional staff for the provision of adequate services.

records.rule_scope: who may provide resident care and services at all
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: Ensure all resident care and services are provided only by staff persons who have the training, credentials, experience, and other qualifications necessary to provide the care and services
records.source_quote: (e) Ensure all resident care and services are provided only by staff persons who have the training, credentials, experience, and other qualifications necessary to provide the care and services;

records.rule_scope: written 24-hour work schedule the facility must keep and show to residents on request
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The facility must maintain a written work schedule that reflects its 24-hour staffing pattern for a given time period
records.source_quote: (c) The facility must maintain a written work schedule that reflects its 24-hour staffing pattern for a given time period. Upon request, the facility must make the daily work schedules of direct care staff available to residents or their representatives.

records.rule_scope: written plan of operation naming the staff involved and the time estimated for each duty
records.minimum_staffing_requirement: The administrator shall prepare a plan of operation for each licensed facility specifying the staff involved, their regularly assigned duties and the amount of time estimated to be spent for each duty
records.source_quote: (d) The administrator shall prepare a plan of operation for each licensed facility specifying the staff involved, their regularly assigned duties and the amount of time estimated to be spent for each duty. There shall be a current plan of operation on file in the facility, available for review by the Division of Health Service Regulation and the county department of social services.
